$comment: Default user settings (one home; the popup can override them, stored in chrome.storage.local).

engine.$biberArgs: --output-safechars works around a biber-wasm bug: non-ASCII from LaTeX macros (e.g. {\"u}) is emitted decomposed and double UTF-8 encoded, which LaTeX rejects (U+0088). Remaining glitch: alphabetic labels (labelalpha) with such names stay garbled.
engine.$maxProjects: Projects whose files the engine keeps in memory between compiles (least recently used ones are dropped and re-sent when needed).

$maxSyncChunkBytes: Largest single message to the engine (Chrome's limit is 64 MB); bigger syncs are split.
$engineIdleMinutes: Close the engine (frees its memory) when no Overleaf tab used it for this long; 0 keeps it running.
$serverOnMissingFonts: If fonts fontspec asks for can't be provided locally, compile on the server instead (the local PDF would use a fallback font).
$joinRetries: Attempts per document join or file download before giving up (busy servers time out or rate-limit now and then); the delay doubles each retry unless the server says how long to wait.
$joinTimeoutMs: How long to wait for the server to answer a joinDoc before retrying.
$maxRetryAfterMs: Longest Retry-After (server rate limit) the extension waits for before giving up on a download.
$serverOnMissingPackages: If the document needs TeX Live files the engine can't get (e.g. a class missing on remoteEndpoint), compile on the server instead. Missing project files (typos) don't count.
